==English==

===Etymology 1===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₁ers-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|erren}}, from {{der|en|fro|errer||to wander, err, mistake}}, from {{der|en|la|errō||wander, stray, err, mistake|pos=verb}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*h₁ers-||to be angry, lose one's temper}}. Cognate with {{cog|ang|eorre}}, {{m|ang|ierre||anger, wrath, ire}}, {{cog|ang|iersian||to be angry with, rage, irritate, provoke}}, {{cog|ang|ierre||wandering, gone astray, confused}}.

====Pronunciation====
* {{IPA|en|/ɜː/|a=RP}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-err.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɛɚ/|/ɝ/|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɛɹ/|a=US,non-Mary-merry}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɛr/|a=Scotland}}
* {{IPA|en|/øː/|a=NZ}}
* {{IPA|en|/eː/|a=Scouse,square-nurse}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɛː/|a=Humberside,Teesside,square-nurse}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɜː(ɹ)/|a=Lancashire,square-nurse}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)|ɛə(ɹ)|ɛr|s=1}}
* {{homophones|en|er<q:all non-US pronunciations, /ɝ/ US pronunciation:>}}
* {{homophones|en|air<a:/ɛɚ/ US pronunciation, all <<square-nurse>> pronunciations:>|are<gloss:unit of measurement>|ayr|Ayr|e'er|ere|eyre|heir}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|formal}} To make a [[mistake]].
#: {{ux|en|He '''erred''' in his calculations, and made many mistakes.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1910|author=James P. Porter|title=Intelligence and Imitation in Birds; A Criterion of Imitation|chapter=2|url=https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Intelligence_and_Imitation_in_Birds;_A_Criterion_of_Imitation#err|page=7
|passage=Artificial tests, then, can hardly '''err''' on the side of supplying too many opportunities for one bird to see another perform the act which is the model.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[sin]].
#: {{ux|en|To '''err''' is human, to forgive, divine.}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} to [[stray]].
